title: Make sure you have a container that is large enough to hold these!!
text: Make sure you have a container that is large enough to hold these!!. Oh my goodness! These are HUGE ice cubes and 99% of my glassware is not wide enough to hold a 2.5" cube! I can really only fit these into a larger pitcher, so I'll still get some good out of them... but I am placing a new order for cubes that are 1.5" in size so that I can pop them into any old glass and enjoy.

product_metadata.title: Cocktail Cube Extra Large Ice Cube Silicone Trays - 2.5 inches - Whiskey Drinks - Freeze Food - Soap Making Molds - Black - 2 Trays
